fusions.name: Spit Ember
fusions.desc: Spits an ember that deals 4 fire damage to the first enemy within 6 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 12% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: A Day's Sun Released
fusions.desc: Releases the heat stored in your scales, dealing 28 fire damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and setting them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Warmed Blood
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking by the Blaze
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 10% fire resistance.
